default_scope: Do not execute these comparison cases by default in either engine. Hail has no usable Vail comparison; Vail has a confirmed missing API/workflow or unresolved adapter limitation. Existing observations remain valid historical evidence.
exclusion_evidence_rule: Both Vail storage modes supplied explicit missing-API/unimplemented-operation or harness-limitation receipts; no successful Vail observation contradicted the exclusion. Generic failures, panics, TypeErrors, missing files, and timeouts are not sufficient evidence.
probe_policy: Only probe an exact excluded case when a functionality or adapter fix is suspected. Supply --case, --probe-excluded and a concrete --probe-reason; never blanket-probe the exclusion list.
